SELECT s.full_name, a.attendance_percentage, AVG(g.marks) AS average_marks, f.amount_due - f.amount_paid AS unpaid_fees FROM students AS s JOIN attendance AS a ON a.student_id = s.student_id JOIN grades AS g ON g.student_id = s.student_id JOIN fees AS f ON f.student_id = s.student_id WHERE s.class_name = 'Grade 8' AND a.attendance_percentage < 75 GROUP BY s.student_id, s.full_name, a.attendance_percentage, f.amount_due, f.amount_paid HAVING AVG(g.marks) < 50 AND f.amount_due - f.amount_paid > 15000 ORDER BY unpaid_fees DESC;
